description: A text note resizable from 3HP to 300HP by dragging either edge, scrolling as the cursor moves and holding a title as well as body text; narrowed to 8HP or less it shows the title as a vertical label
notes: a new one is empty; click in the window and type, and the text is kept in the patch file
arrow keys move the cursor, Home and End reach the top and bottom of the text, and PgUp and PgDown move a screen at a time
no more than the first 1000 screen lines of the text can be reached, so widening the module reaches more of it
right-clicking the text window gives Cut, Copy, Paste and Select all; the module's own menu is on the panel border around that window
menu: Set Title — the heading over a text field for the title shown above the text, which becomes the whole of the display at narrow widths
Visible Lines — picks the font size by the number of lines shown at once, from 28 down to a single very large line
Font — picks the typeface, from VCV font (like Notes), four RobotoMono weights and three RobotoSlab weights
Screen Colors — picks the ink and paper of the window from seven pairs
